name: AGEL085413-042409 (Hubble)
blurb: AGEL085413-042409, a gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: dcls08540424-hubble
story: What looks like a small spiral with curling arms is a cosmic mirage: the arms are two distant galaxies, each multiply imaged by the gravity of a single foreground galaxy.

claims.text: AGEL085413-042409A has a morphology reminiscent of spiral arms
The arms are two distant galaxies multiply lensed by one foreground galaxy
The Hubble image of this system is labeled DCLS0854-0424
